name: kairos
description: Understand an unfamiliar codebase and see the potential ripple effects of changing a file — files, functions, and non-code relationships.

kairos.includeHistory.description: Include git co-change history (files that frequently changed alongside the selected file) as 'historical' entries in the impact view. Off by default: it costs an extra git-log walk per analysis.

kairos.includeFunctions.description: Include the function/method call graph (who calls this function, what it calls) in the impact view. Off by default: it parses every source file's function bodies.

kairos.includeCrossFile.description: Include non-import relationships: HTML <-> JS (ids, script tags, inline handlers), templates, stylesheets, and config files (env vars, properties/YAML keys, package.json entry points). Off by default.
